name: Griffin
description: The Griffin is a creature with the body of a lion and the head, wings, and talons of an eagle. It is known for its strength and agility, capable of flying at high speeds and hunting with its sharp claws. It's eyes are capable of spotting prey and threats from a great distance.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: The griffin lashes out with it's claws dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Talon Strike
actions.description: The griffin makes an attack with the talons on it's front legs, dealing physical damage. The targeted character must make a resilience check equal to or greater than the total damage dealt after mitigation or gain the bleeding condition.

actions.name: Dive Bomb
actions.description: If the griffin starts it turn in the air, it can target a creature between 4 and 8 units that is below it and move to an empty space adjacent to it. The next Claw or Talon Strike action the griffin takes has its true hit threshold increased by 1 and is upgraded to a brutal critical in the event of a true hit.

actions.name: Soft Landing
actions.description: In response to falling, the griffin spreads its wings and stops its descent.

traits.name: Hunter
traits.description: The griffin is an exceptional hunter and gains a 1d4 attack bonus against small beasts and monsters.

traits.name: Active Flight
traits.description: The griffin must spend at least 1 action per round to maintain their height while flying, otherwise, they immediately fall at the end of their turn.
